easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
